name: Cafunfo

queries.query: Cafunfo Angola official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry; Angola official cadastre parcel map GIS registration land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola (IGCA) national cartography/cadastre authority and official government property-registration portals. It did not identify a Cafunfo municipal parcel viewer, public map service, or anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint.

queries.query: Cafunfo Angola cadastro predial mapa parcelas registo predial; Angola cadastro predial plataforma oficial geoserver
queries.result: A pesquisa em português encontrou o IGCA como autoridade nacional, legislação/procedures describing the Sistema Integrado de Cadastro Predial and Número de Identificação Predial, and the official Inscreva Já property-registration campaign. No Cafunfo/local cadastral map, public parcel layer, service configuration, or bounded anonymous geometry response was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola (IGCA) is evidenced as the national cartography/cadastre authority, not as a Cafunfo-local public parcel service.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official sources describe national cadastral and registration institutions/services. No local Cafunfo registry custodian, municipal cadastral viewer, or public parcel endpoint was evidenced in this attempt. National agency prose and a registration campaign were not treated as local service proof.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. The returned page identifies IGCA and lists services/news, but the HTML is a static/template-like site and exposed no public map viewer, JavaScript service configuration, parcel layer, schema, CRS, native parcel ID, or geometry endpoint.

HTTP 200. Public landing page for the official national property-registration campaign. JavaScript inspection exposed authentication-backed registration workflows and service hosts, but no anonymous parcel map/API or Cafunfo geometry route. No login, credentials, token, or private fields were requested.

TLS certificate verification failed (local issuer unavailable); TLS verification was preserved and no exception was used. The related official public guide describes login-required property pre-registration, not an anonymous parcel geometry service.

TLS certificate verification failed because the certificate was expired; TLS verification was preserved and no exception was used. Search result content was a general official Registo Predial page, not a public parcel map/API.

Official ministry news describes the JUCDF workflow integrating municipal administration, IGCA, tax administration, and property registries. It exposes no anonymous parcel geometry or public map service.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: The national registration portals may contain non-public, authenticated, or non-indexed cadastral data; no login or private access was attempted.
The IGCA site and official government pages did not expose a current public viewer/configuration or anonymous parcel API from this workspace.
TLS failures on two official hosts are transport evidence only and are not evidence of cadastral absence.
No parcel polygon is retained because no safe source geometry and stable native identity were verified.
